title: EXP-103-R3 - Replay of Hello World Part 7 Section 3 with Observed Option Names: FX_CustomerPortal Root FlexLayout Type VerticalBox, Regions header (4 FormUnit, Fill), main (1 Flex, Fill), footer (2 FormUnit, Fill); One Designer Save; Readback After Reopen

Designer gate (read-only except at most one reopen): User scope; record which Form is open (EXP-103-R2 left FX_CustomerPortal open and clean), that nothing is dirty (Save disabled) and that no Error dialog or other dialog is open. If FX_CustomerPortal is not open, open it once through the Designer Form menu recent-forms entry (never Select Form OK); if another clean Form is open, close it once through its Form-tab control first. Server-event rule (EXP-103-R2 lesson): if any action raises 'The server event processing returned an error', answer OK once, record it and stop blocked for an operator Designer reload; never try another route, retry, close or reopen after that error.

Selection test: select flexlayoutPane_FX_CustomerPortal once by a click on its row in Details > Components and record with a screenshot whether an Error dialog appears and whether the Properties grid shows the Design group (Name, Description, Type FlexLayout, From Device Master). On error or an empty grid, apply the server-event rule. Never click a Region row's delete or the Components trash icon.

Pre-change check (T1, read-only): open Edit FlexLayout Attributes once through the canvas control (the first small FlexLayout icon at the top left of the canvas; tooltip 'Edit FlexLayout Attributes'). Confirm, with a screenshot, that the dialog is populated and still shows the EXP-103-R2 values (Type HorizontalBox; regions FLEX_PANE_REGION0-2 each 1 Flex). Open no list; change nothing; leave with Cancel once and verify Save is still disabled. If the dialog is empty or shows different values, record them, Cancel and stop blocked.

Change (T2): run the gate and the selection test again read-only (a fresh selection click is allowed if the FlexLayout is not selected), open the dialog once through the canvas control and set, in this order: Type = VerticalBox; region index 0: ID header, Length 4, Unit FormUnit, Orientation Fill; region index 1: ID main, Length 1, Unit Flex (already Flex; verify, do not re-select), Orientation Fill; region index 2: ID footer, Length 2, Unit FormUnit, Orientation Fill. Select each region row before editing it. Leave every other attribute (Alignment, Pack, Minimum Length, Maximum Length, Default Margin and the rest) at its current value. Use the existing three regions; never add, delete or reorder a region. Record each value as displayed after entry, and the Regions grid after all entries, with a screenshot before OK. At most one correction per field. If any named option is missing, record the available options and stop blocked with Cancel before OK. Confirm with OK once and record any prompt or message verbatim; then perform exactly one Designer Save and record its response, the Save state afterwards and the canvas (expected: three stacked rows). Never retry a Save; never Save after an error.

Readback (T3): close the clean FX_CustomerPortal once through its Form-tab control (answer No to any save prompt, record its text), reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry, select the FlexLayout, open Edit FlexLayout Attributes read-only and record Type and every region's ID, Length, Unit and Orientation (screenshot each region selected). Also record the Components tree region names and the canvas arrangement. Leave the dialog with Cancel and the Form open and clean (Save disabled).

Capture screenshots of the gate, any close or reopen, the moment after each FlexLayout selection, the dialog before any change, each region after its entries, the Regions grid before OK, the OK and Save responses, the canvas after Save, and the readback. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task (not from find output); after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. ExtJS comboboxes are not <select> elements (EXP-101): open their list and click the option. Classify findings as observed only.

notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-103-R2 (operator decision 2026-10-16: 'Yes, R3 with FormUnit').
